description: This file contains database migration scripts and configuration updates for migrating from vtiger CRM version 5.0.3 to 5.0.4 RC. It includes SQL queries to modify database schema, insert email templates, and update existing data to support new features and fixes in the migration process.

methods.name: alter_picklist_tables
methods.description: Modifies the structure of picklist tables by dropping and adding columns for picklist value IDs.

methods.name: insert_picklist_table
methods.description: Inserts a new picklist entry into vtiger_picklist and populates its values for all roles.

methods.name: insert_values
methods.description: Populates picklist values and assigns role-based permissions for each value.
